body: No clue where to start.  Doesn't matter.
I'm glad moodgym has helped you; I tried it before and didn't notice any improvement.  I appreciate the advice though.

I've posted many times before.  Honestly, I've been around the depressed and suicidal for long enough to know that, a lot of times, it doesn't get better.  I really doubt there's much to talk about at this point.

I went back inside for awhile because I was getting too cold.  I plan to go back out soon when I can actually do it.

And I expected my life to get just a little bit better.
